reviewer_role: Independent source-transcription reviewer working from the retained primary PDF; not independent scientific peer review or legal clearance.

source.title: Sustainable Reinforcement for Rubbers—Potential Application of Recycled Carbon Fibers
source.source_record_hash_method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) followed by one LF.
source.source_reuse_boundary: Reuse the existing source record without changing its bytes or claiming a new source. This review supplies the additional selected tensile-table evidence separately.

inspection.method: Independent extraction plus direct visual inspection of rendered PDF pages 1, 3, 4 and 6; text inspection of the separate foaming section on page 10 and conclusions on page 11.
inspection.selected_scope: Table 3 composition columns B–G, Table 4 tensile-strength cells B–G, section 2.1 input identification, section 2.2 tensile-test protocol, section 2.3 preparation, section 3.3 aggregation statement and source discrepancy, article-specific license and selected-content exclusions.

recipe.locator: Table 3, PDF page 4, printed page 61279, columns B, C, D, E, F and G.
recipe.basis_boundary: Preserve the source's phr formulation basis with NBR fixed at 100. Do not normalize these amounts to complete-compound wt.% or claim final cured elemental stoichiometry.
recipe.input_identity_locator: Section 2.1 and Table 2, PDF page 3, printed page 61278.
recipe.matrix: The section 2.1 text identifies PERBUNAN 3445 F; Table 2 abbreviates the trade name to Perbunan 3445. These identify the NBR input, not six separate finished-material grades.
recipe.filler: Recycled milled carbon fiber, Table 2 code mCF and trade name Type 45; the article also uses rCF. The six identities differ by the source-supported filler amount.
recipe.sulfur_input_boundary: The Table 3 Sul row is linked by Table 2 to ACTMIX S-80. Retain the source-reported 1.5 phr input amount; do not reinterpret it as a verified pure-element sulfur mass fraction or infer the product's carrier composition.
recipe.other_input_boundary: Table 2 identifies PEG, stearic acid, zinc oxide and dibenzothiazyl disulfide. Trademarks are qualified input identifiers and do not establish finished-mixture chemical purity.
unreported_details: Complete elemental or molecular stoichiometry of the cured compounds
Exact recovered-fiber sizing, residual matrix or surface-contaminant fractions
Product lot and full composition of compounded commercial inputs

property_contract.locator: Table 4, PDF page 6, printed page 61281, rows B–G and column tensile strength (MPa).
property_contract.aggregation_locator: Section 3.3 immediately below Table 4, PDF page 6, printed page 61281.
property_contract.aggregation_evidence: The text states that the tensile results were averaged across all specimens regardless of the two tested orientations. Preserve a reported mean; do not claim a specified arithmetic estimator, directional value, independent replication or raw-data reanalysis.
property_contract.uncertainty_scope: Table 4 presents plus/minus amplitudes without identifying the tensile-strength amplitudes as SD, SEM or CI. The section 2.2 SD statements specifically accompany hardness and abrasion; nearby section 3.3 SD wording concerns strain at break. None establishes the selected strength statistic.
property_contract.sample_size_boundary: Do not transfer the 300 measured fibers, ten hardness points or three abrasion pieces to the tensile-strength result count.
property_contract.orientation: Results averaged across specimens tested in two mutually perpendicular orientations; exact directions and specimen counts by direction are unspecified.

method_and_state.method_locator: Section 2.2, PDF page 3, printed page 61278, tensile-test paragraph.
method_and_state.loading_scope: Tensile tests; do not substitute tear-test ISO 34 Method B or infer strain rate from crosshead speed.
method_and_state.mixing: Brabender Lab-Station with an Intermix 350SX chamber; 110 °C set temperature; 15 rpm for 8 min then 40 rpm for 4 min.
method_and_state.sheet_and_cure: Nominal 2 mm vulcanized sheets, hot pressed at 170 °C and 200 bar; pressing time based on each compound's t90; specimens cut from the sheets with standard dies.
method_and_state.state_boundary: Mixing and cure temperatures are not tensile-test temperatures. Nominal sheet thickness is not a full measured specimen geometry. Do not add unreported gauge dimensions, conditioning, moisture content or zero porosity.

locators: Table 4 rows REF and D, PDF page 6, printed page 61281
source_discrepancies.observation: The abstract claims a 15% tensile-strength increase at 20 phr. Table 4 instead reports D at 5.33 ± 0.74 MPa and REF at 6.01 ± 1.15 MPa.
source_discrepancies.disposition: Retain the exact selected Table 4 values and this unresolved source conflict. Do not replace values with the abstract's claim, claim a strength improvement, infer a corrected table, or present a published erratum.

precision_note.locator: Section 3.3 below Table 4, PDF page 6, printed page 61281.
precision_note.observation: The prose mentions the E tensile result as 5.467 MPa while Table 4 prints 5.47 MPa.
precision_note.disposition: Preserve the selected table's 5.47 lexical precision; this is consistent with rounding and does not justify silently replacing the selected cell.

identity_and_scope.identity_basis: Six formulations with distinct source-reported mCF loadings of 5, 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50 phr under the same Table 3 base recipe. This is formulation distinction rather than another temperature, orientation, state or alias.
identity_and_scope.excluded_existing_ref: REF has mCF=0 and is already represented. Its tensile and density values are context only and do not add an identity in this batch.
identity_and_scope.excluded_foam: Section 3.4 and Table 5 on PDF page 10 describe D_Fo with added ADCA and separate foaming conditions. It is outside this six-row tensile batch; no claim is made here that its recipe is chemically identical to D, and no foam/state identity is counted.
identity_and_scope.novelty_boundary: This source review establishes the selected formulation differences, not whole-catalog uniqueness. The inventory owner must separately bind the exact baseline and candidate novelty check.
identity_and_scope.excluded_properties: Strain at break, M100, M200, hardness, abrasion, tear, curing characteristics and foam density/porosity are not imported as additional properties or materials in this batch.

rights_review.license_locator: PDF page 1, printed page 61276, top-right article-specific license notice.
rights_review.license_notice: This article is licensed under CC-BY 4.0
rights_review.selected_content_scope: Article-authored formulation and tensile-result cells in Tables 3 and 4, bounded input and method facts, bibliographic metadata, source locators, and original curation notes.
rights_review.selected_table_credits: No separate third-party credit is printed on the inspected Table 3 or Table 4.
rights_review.third_party_exclusion: Figure 1 on PDF page 1 explicitly credits Ceresana with a separate permission/copyright notice. Exclude that figure and its market-demand values; the article license is not a blanket claim over all embedded third-party content.
rights_review.other_exclusions: Exclude raw PDF pages, screenshots, article prose extracts, figures, source tables as assets, and supplier property values not selected for this batch.
